final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orderexecutions oe JOIN orders o ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.ordertune), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_sum FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.ordertune, s1.cnt, s1.cnt / CAST(s2.total_sum AS FLOAT) AS ratio FROM step1 s1 CROSS JOIN step2 s2 WHERE s2.total_sum IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT s3.ordertune, s3.cnt, s3.ratio, s3.ratio - s4.avg_ratio AS diff FROM step3 s3 CROSS JOIN step4 s4 WHERE s4.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL AND s3.ratio > s4.avg_ratio) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(diff) AS avg_diff FROM step5
